items.note: ComboBox reports Escape as an option commit when `selectedKey` and `inputValue` are both controlled (A)
a stacked ContainedModal loses its inert background when the modal under it closes first (A)
`DetailList layout="block" values="figures"` draws two columns (A+B; B's copy is a duplicate of this)
`.table th/td` outranks DataGrid's `.empty` and its disclosure-column rules (A)

Dialog's contained path drops most `ModalOverlay` props (A+B; B's copy is a duplicate). It now forwards DOM props, `style`, `isEntering` and `isExiting`, and warns that it ignores `onEnter`, `onExit`, `UNSTABLE_deferUntilEntered` and `render`. That warning is a strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.
Dialog's Basic story says a click outside closes it (A+B; B's copy is a duplicate)

ComboBox fires no `onCommit` when the already-selected option is picked again (A+B; B's copy is a duplicate). A's click case is not a defect: React Aria already reports a click on the selected option. Enter was the real gap.
CycleButton throws on an empty `options` (A+B; B's copy is a duplicate). It now renders disabled, named by its `aria-label`. That is a strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.
the command palette shows "No matching actions." while it fades out (B)
content added to a contained modal's root after it opens stays interactive (B). Overlays (`data-weasel-overlay`) are left alone, so a popover or a stacked dialog stays usable.
DataGrid sorts text by UTF-16 code unit, and a column mixing numbers and text sorts inconsistently (B)
